title: 지금이 나중에
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop, City Pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and bright arpeggios. A synth bass performs a melodic, walking line with a rounded, analog tone. Drums feature a crisp snare and a tight kick drum. Shimmering digital pads and a bright, bell-like synth lead provide melodic accents. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor with occasional falsetto transitions. The arrangement uses a 4/4 time signature at 105 BPM in the key of E Major. Production features light chorus on the guitars and short plate reverb on the vocals.
